rappel_detail.notes: First of two rappels using a single 60m rope; tie stopper knots since the rappel is close to the rope's max length.
Second rappel reaches the base of the formation.
rappel_detail.anchor: bolted anchor near tree, north end

set.rappels: 2 rappels with a 60 m rope from the anchor near a stand of fir trees at the north end of the formation, down the East Face (one long rappel with two ropes)
set.rappel_count_note: Can be done as 1 rappel instead with two ropes tied together
